$comment: The ruled wordings of the shared legal clauses, published by legal.333.eco at https://legal.333.eco/clauses.json.
Generated from legal.333.eco's clauses; never edit a copy: a service's scripts/check-clauses.mjs fails on any edit.
An id is <clause>/<lang>, or <clause>/<lang>@<host> for the form that host carries instead (`instead`) or alone.
`then` names the slot that follows the text, which is each service's own (the bank's rail clause, a service's own Changes sentences).
